title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
abstract: arXiv:2610.21074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend

translated_title: OmicsBench：一个面向研究级规模生物信息学的AI智能体长程多轮基准测试
translated_abstract: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析工作委托给AI智能体在长程、多轮会话中完成，然而现有大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准仅通过单次提示提出一个简短任务。我们提出了OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长程、多轮生物信息学基准测试。其97个任务中，每个任务都将相互依赖的子任务链接成有向无环图，共包含662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并对照答案密钥进行确定性评分，还可针对错误答案提供可选的上下文内反馈。在三种测试框架上对12个模型进行评估，最慢的智能体平均每个任务耗时3.6小时，且没有任何模型与框架组合接近使该基准饱和——在无上下文内反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1分），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，例如智能体在依赖前置子任务的任务上得分更低（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: OmicsBench提出了首个面向AI智能体的长程多轮生物信息学基准，将97个研究级任务组织为包含662个依赖子任务的有向无环图并进行确定性评分，实验表明当前12个模型远未饱和该基准。
en_tdlr: OmicsBench introduces a long-horizon, multi-turn benchmark for AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics, organizing 97 tasks into DAGs of 662 dependent subtasks with deterministic grading, and shows that 12 current models fall far short of saturating it.
